ASSIMILATED_DESC:
Ten gatunek jest asymilowany. Co miesiąc 100 £ populacji zmienia się tak, by lepiej pasować do gatunku dominującego w imperium.

Liczba £ populacji asymilowanych co miesiąc wzrasta o modyfikatory £ populacji optymalizowanych co miesiąc.

EMPIRE_DESIGN_AcamarianSovereignty_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Acamarians are an intelligent humanoid civilisation from the world of Acamar III. Physically their distinguishing external physical traits include a formed indentation on their foreheads. Their blood is comprised an iron and copper base, a rarity among species in this area of the galaxy. Many Acamarians have traditional facial tattoos as well.

The Acamarians are governed by a representative government headed by a Sovereign, whilst their legislative body is known as the Acamarian Ruling Council.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_AndorianEmpire_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Easy Difficulty

The Andorians are a humanoid species from the large moon Andoria, which orbits a large gas giant in the Andor system.

Most Andorians are known for their blue skin with white or silver hair, with blue blood and two antenna on their head. Their metabolism is higher than that of humans, leaving them vulnerable to phasers; however they are also extremely resilient to a wide range of environmental conditions.

In the polar regions of Andoria, there exists a small subspecies of Andorians with white skin, blind but telepathic, called the Aenar.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_AntedianShoals_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Antedeans are a species that is fish-like in appearance, but of similar size as many other humanoids and capable of bipedal motion. Native to the large oceans of Antede III, they are somewhat reclusive as they live under the ocean.

Whilst Antedeans have discovered warp, they find spaceflight extremely traumatic and survive the ordeal by entering a self-induced catatonic state. Upon arrival at the end of a voyage, Antedeans require great quantities of food to replenish their bodies.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_AnticanPacks_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

A humanoid canine species from the planet Antica. Anticans are fiercely carnivorous, even preferring to eat their prey alive, or to kill them with a short energy blade immediately before eating.

Anticans have a long and brutally violent history with their close neighbours, the reptilian Selay. As if to exemplify the intensity of their conflict, the Anticans will gladly kill and eat any Selay they can.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_ArgrathianCommonwealth_des:
£ Gamma Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Argrathi are a humanoid species from the planet Argratha in the Gamma Quadrant.

They are physiologically similar to humans, but with facial folds and ridges across their body.

The Argrathi are known for their unique justice system where, using advanced mind altering techniques, they can implant false memories of imprisonment on those they arrest and charge with crimes.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_BajoranRepublic_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Bajorans are a humanoid species from the planet Bajor.

Bajorans resemble Humans to a large degree, though are distinguished by a series of horizontal creases across their nose. Bajorans have a deeply spiritual society, and the Bajoran religion is a major unifying force on the planet.

The spiritual leader of the Bajorans, or Kai, wields a great deal of moral and political authority, advising and influencing the planet's political leaders.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_BenzarianCommonwealth_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Benzites are a species of humanoids native to the planet Benzar.

Benzites typically have smooth, hairless, blue skin. A thick protrusion of the Benzite skull extended down over the face, displaying a prominent nasal lobe and brow. They are unable to breathe a standard oxygen/nitrogen atmosphere, and sometimes must wear a respiration device in those environments.

Benzites are known for being highly meticulous.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_BetazoidHouses_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Betazoids are a humanoid, telepathic and empathic race. Having long ago developed empathic abilities to fight a war against non-corporeal entities, the Betazoids themselves have enjoyed little internecine conflict. The Betazoid Houses are familial, matriarchal organizations which make up a planetary council that speaks for all citizens, and whose lineage is traced back to legendary figures in Betazoid society. 

Having recently broken the warp barrier in the Avandar, the Betazoids are ready to join the intergalactic community.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_BolianLeague_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Bolians are a humanoid species from the planet Bolarus in the Beta Quadrant. 

They are curious and sociable, and one of their most important institutions is the Bank of Bolias.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_BorgCollective_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Easy Difficulty

The Borg unique fusion of biology and technology originated hundreds of thousands of years ago, but only in the last millennia has the Collective truly started to expand beyond the boundaries of its home system. Once the home world system was discarded in order to give birth to vast Unicomplex structures, the Collective turned its eyes outward, seeking out fresh new resources and cultures that will enhance their cultural and technological uniqueness and allow them to reach true perfection - Omega.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_BreenConfederacy_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Average Difficulty

Shrouded in mystery, the Breen are seemingly a species of humanoids native to the planet Breen.

The Breen constantly wear refrigeration suits as their physiology is among the most exotic for humanoid lifeforms, which might have developed due to the climate of their home planet. Given that most known humanoid species live on class M planets with an average temperature far above the supposed temperature of Breen, the Breen are largely thought to have had to develop refrigeration suits in order to coexist with others.

The Breen are known to use slave labour of lesser species in their mines and construction programmes.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_BrunaliEmpire_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Brunali are a humanoid species native to the Delta Quadrant.

Physiologically similar to humans, they have a distinguishing large facial ridge that bisects the forehead.

They are known for their agricultural prowess and genetic engineering.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_BynarDomains_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

Like the Borg, the Bynars have also reached technological perfection - the merge of the analogue with the digital. Unlike the Borg, however, the Bynars have retained their individuality, compassion and empathy, and while they are incredibly reliant on their main planetary computer, they are a productive member of intergalactic society.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_CaitianUnion_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Caitians are a humanoid, intelligent species who strongly prize loyalty within, and between individuals.The Caitian Union itself is made up of many clans, who work together for the good of the Caitian Union. Caitians are a felinoid species native to the planet Cait. While the skin of some them are covered with fur that varies in color from orange to black, are other Caitians without fur or trimmed down completely. Female Caitians grow long Human-like hair on their heads and speak with a soft, cat-like purring quality. Some Caitians do not find it necessary to use footwear.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_CardassianUnion_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Easy Difficulty

The Cardassians are a quasi-reptilian humanoid species native to the planet Cardassia.

They appear to have evolved from a creature with both reptilian and mammalian traits, with both gray or grayish-green skin tones and dark black hair. Elongated vertebrae extend along their necks, and ridges extend along their forehead.

The Cardassians have a general belief that they are superior to other species in the galaxy and all should serve them.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_ChelarianSovereignty_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

Originally hailing from the Rigel system and having migrated to their new home on Chelar, the Chelarians are an aquatic long lives species of sentient Turtles, through their long lives they look to seek out wisdom. Whilst mosy Chelarians do not move fast, when provoked they are quick to anger and are not afraid to quarrel amongst themselves, with debates often lasting days!
EMPIRE_DESIGN_CheroniteNation_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Cheronites are a humanoid species, possessing an incredibly long lifespan. Members of the Cheronite species are half-black and half-white, split along the mid-sagittal plane. The Cheronite nation is tightly controlled by the Commission of Political Traitors, that has dictated that Cheronites that are 'white on the right side' have a strong genetic tendency toward crime and violence. They are treated as little more than slaves by the elite, those that are 'black on the right side'.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_ConfederationEarth_desc:
Alternate Start - Replaces United Earth

£ Alpha Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Road not taken has led humanity down it's darkest path. Humanity's failure to undo the harm it inflicted on it's homeworld during the 21st Century led it to turn to the revolutionary Dr. Adam Soong whose advanced genetic theories led to the formation of the Confederation of Earth and a society that puts humanity first no matter the results.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_CravicImperative_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Cravic are a crazed species of artificially intelligent androids, also called Automated Personnel Units, A.P.U, in their own nomenclature. The Cravic A.P.U's were created as servants and soldiers against the Pralor in the hundred-year Pralor-Cravic war. When both sides attempted to settle and declare peace, their own creations turned against them - only to continue the war in earnest, as soon as the organics were eliminated.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_DeltanUnion_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Deltans are a humanoid species originating from the planet Delta IV. They are identified by their bald scalps and are known to wear head dresses. Their strong sexual attraction can be a distraction for members of other species. While Deltans have pain-relieving abilities that manifest during tactile contact, this ability does not heal injuries.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_DenobulanUnity_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Average Difficulty

An ever optimistic and very long-lived people from the planet Denobula. Due to a population of almost 12 billion, all concentrated on a single continent, the Denobulans adopted a close-knit communal lifestyle. Denobulan families are hugely complex, with the average Denobulan having 3 spouses and hundreds of familial relations.

Due to their communal and upbeat nature, Denobulans prefer to find ways to positively contribute to galactic society. The Interspecies Medical Exchange stands as an excellent example of this. However they aren't afraid of war, as several brutal wars with the Antarans demonstrated.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_DevoreImperium_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Devore are a humanoid species from the Delta Quadrant.

Not much is known of the Devore, except for their intolerance of foreigneres and hatred of telepaths.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_DosiConfederacy_desc:
£ Gamma Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Dosi are a humanoid species native to the Gamma Quadrant.

Their faces are often painted in a variety of colours and markings to denote status, rank and house. The most common is red with white stripes. Trade and economic matters are an important part of Dosi culture, and they place great importance on it.

The Dosi are also extremely aggressive negotiators, the combination of which means that fatalities during business deals are not uncommon.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_ElaurianAuditorium_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

They were a long-lived race of 'listeners' who possessed perceptive abilities that extended beyond the normal. All this culture and wisdom could not save the El-Aurians when the Borg came for them in 2265, but anything is possible within the ST: New Horizons universe.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_FenDomarStates_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Easy Difficulty

The Fen Domar are a humanoid species native to the far reaches of the Beta Quadrant.

They are distinguished by their grey to green skin colouration and grey hair, often with markings in to denote status.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_FerengiAlliance_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Ferengi are a humanoid species from the planet Ferenginar. They are known for their civilisation which is built on a foundation of free enterprise, where earning profit is the sole meaningful goal in life.

Ferengi are shorter than most humanoids with orange-brown skin, enlarged skulls, wrinkled noses and sharp teeth.

Their most distinguishing feature is their large ears - or lobes - which give them extremely acute hearing.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_FlaxianHegemony_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Flaxians are a humanoid race from the planet Flaxos in the Beta Quadrant.

Little is known of this species, but numerous assassinations have been reported in areas where Flaxians reside.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_GaridianRepublic_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Garidians use the same shipset as the Romulans.

The Garidians are a humanoid civilisation with signs of Vulcanoid evolution who are associated with the Romulan Star Empire.

The Garidians are very similar to Romulans, however they have genetically pure white hair.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_GornEmpire_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Gorn are a bipedal reptilian species native to the planet Gornar.

A cold-blooded species with green, rubbery skin and an average height of two meters means they are physically imposing as well as being stronger than most humanoids, albeit slower and less agile.

They prefer warmer temperatures, but can survive briefly in the vacuum of space. They possess incredible durability and can take an extreme amount of punishment.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_HaakonianOrder_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Haakonians are a warp-capable, humanoid species from the Delta Quadrant. Physically the Haakonians are tall and pale skinned and, like most species, susceptible to metreon poisoning. That does not stop them from experimenting with this dangerous technology.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_HazariTuatara_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Hazari are a cold blooded reptilian species who thrive on life as a bounty hunters, travelling across the sector to hunt and capture those who are wanted by others.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_HirogenHunters_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

Seen as nothing more than brutal, nomadic savages, the Hirogen actually have a proud, technologically advanced society that is older than most species in the galaxy. Incredibly tall and powerful, the Hirogens are capable warriors and hunters, terrorising the galaxy.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_HurQStagnancy_desc:
£ Gamma Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

Hur'Q is a Klingon word meaning 'outsider'. This also is the name given by the Klingons to this species from the Gamma Quadrant which invaded and plundered Qo'noS 1000 years ago.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_HusnockAscendency_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Easy Difficulty

Calculating, aggressive and entirely assured of their supremacy, the Husnock lurk at the edge of known space. Despite their violent nature, the Husnock never fell into internal warfare, and they managed to build a highly effective and technologically advanced society far sooner than most of the galaxy. 

From their homeworld of Hus, the Husnock conducted several blitz attacks on nearby primitive species, entirely subjugating them. The Ascendancy is now a rising superpower, biding its time for its attempt to take over the galaxy.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_HydranKingdom_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Hydrans is the official name of the Hydran government, a society run by numerous trade guilds, several of which possess considerable economic power. It is these trade guilds that often determined who becomes Monarch. The Hydrans are a deeply religious species, whose religion has similarities to animism. They worship of a pantheon of minor gods, as well as space-faring beasts. Every household, starship, and military unit or organization has its own god or set of gods.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_KaremmanFoundation_desc:
£ Gamma Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Karemman are a humanoid species from the Gamma Quadrant. Their society is highly ritualistic and regulated and the Karemman are themselves honest to a fault.

Despite all of that, they have developed a vibrant economic empire built on long-lasting trade agreements and the strong reputation of the Karemma as merchantman.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_KazonSects_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Kazon are an aggressive warrior species from the Delta Quadrant.

Historically, the Kazon were subjugated by a species called the Trabe, who encouraged infighting amongst themselves, but eventually began a rebellion during this period in their history. This has led Kazon society to be made up of warring sects, each with possession of different resources. Nomadic in nature, it takes a strong Jal to unite the sects under their leadership.

Kazon society is very patriarchal, with female Kazon being treated as second class citizens.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_KessokHeliolatry_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Average Difficulty

A mysterious and dangerous species from the uncharted Maelstrom region. 

The Kessok are a silicon-based species with a deep understanding and union with solar entities for stars have the power of life and death.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_KinshayaHolyOrder_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Holy Order is located deep within the Beta Quadrant and has been a traditional rival of many empires that they consider heathens, including the Klingon Empire.

A deeply emotional species, their gargoylesque appearance gives them an almost mythical demeanor. Kinshayan culture is a blend of a religious and military caste system; the Episcopate of the Holy Order, its legislative body, is made up of ruling bishops that rule the Holy Order with an iron fist.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_KlingonEmpire_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Easy Difficulty

The Klingons are a humanoid warrior species from the planet Qo'noS. Distinctive for their head ridges and dark complexions, the Klingons are also known far and wide for their strength and aggressiveness who value honor and tradition.

Historically the Klingons were first united as one under Kahless the Unforgettable over 1100 years ago, and the warrior culture has only grown since then.

The aggressiveness of the Klingon people generally leads to poor relations with other species, and a need to conquer and expand as resources are used up.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_KobaliRepublic_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Kobali are a humanoid species from the planet Kobal in the Delta Quadrant.

Subject to a genetic virus early in their history, the majority of the Kobali species are now unable to reproduce sexually. Instead, the deceased from other species are converted into Kobali via an irreversible genetic virus.

Peaceful and cooperative, the Kobali are frustrated by the revulsion most other species express towards their method of reproduction.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_KraylorRepublic_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Kraylor are a humanoid species who are physically noted for their nose ridges and almost gill-like earlobes. While not much is known about the Kraylor, it's clear that they are resilient and determined, able to face dire situations with guile and clear minded intellect.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_KrenimImperium_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Krenim are a humanoid species from the Delta Quadrant.

Physiologically they are humanoid, with hardened skeletal membranes on their forehead. The Krenim are mainly known for their chroniton and temporal research, though as yet nothing has come of it.

The Krenim have also been known to have border disputes with neighbouring species.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_KriosDynasty_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

Centuries ago the Kriosian Empire was a rich two planet empire that was known across the quadrant. Two brothers, Krios and Valt, both ran the Empire until they met an empathic metamorph named Garuth. Both brothers fell in love with her, until Krios kidnapped her and took her to Krios Prime. This sparked a civil war lasting centuries, splitting the Empire in two and reducing a once great Empire down to a barely warp capable people.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_KzintiEmpire_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Kzinti are a species of aggressive, carnivorous, feline humanoids from the planet Kzin. Their males rule their world, with Kzinti females considered nothing more than dumb animals.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_LissepianParliaments_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

A humanoid species, the Lissepians are known for their strong trading relationships built on their semi-religious compulsion to always pay their debts.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_LurianPrincipality_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Lurians are a species from the planet Luria and are rarely seen outside of the Ionite Nebula region. Their government is controlled by the Royal Family of Luria. They are known to have multiple hearts, four lungs at the minimum and two stomachs. As a result, they are not only more resistant to damage than most species, but are also able to withstand poisons and other toxins much better. They are able to store liquids in their second stomach for many years, if necessary.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_LyranStarEmpire_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Lyrans are believed to be the lost tribe from the Kzin, who left to seek power and expand their military might. Their quarrelsome ways resulted in the formation of the many duchies of the Lyrans, each of whom servers the Star Empire whilst vying for power. The Lyrans are a fierce and formidable empire.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_LyridianDiaspora_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Lyridians are a humanoid species from the Delta Quadrant.

Little is known of the Lyridians, however traders report that their transgalactic star charts are among the most accurate maps of the known galaxy ever created.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_MalonSanctity_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Malon are a warp capable humanoid species from Malon Prime in the Delta Quadrant. An economically minded society; although technologically advanced, the Malon lack the technology to recycle antimatter waste, which emitted hazardous theta radiation which was extremely degenerative and lethal in short exposure. Therefore, lacking any means to safely handle it their hazardous waste was dumped in open space in vast quantities.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_MedusanCorporium_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Medusans are a species of intelligent non-humanoids native to the planet Visalayan in the Xi Hydrae star system, whose outward appearance will drive a Human insane if they look at one directly without a protective visor. The Medusans demonstrate highly advanced scientific capabilities and had telepathic powers that are more advanced than most of the species in the Alpha and Beta Quadrants.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_MoneanMaritimeSovereignty_:
£ Delta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Moneans are a spacefaring humanoid species from the Delta Quadrant. Originally nomadic, in the 21st century they discovered and settled on an artificially coherent planetoid of water, which they termed the Waters. Their government is the Monean Maritime Sovereignty. Although they have built an industrial infrastructure and undersea dwellings, most Moneans still chose to live as their ancestors did, aboard ships.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_MoraliStates_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Morali are a humanoid species from the deep of the Beta Quadrant.

Rumors say they are remotely related to the Orions. Wars are repugnant to them.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_NausicaanTribes_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Nausicaans are an aggressive humanoid species native to the planet Nausicaa.

Renowned for having a lack of subtlety and an ill-tempered manner, they are large humanoids often surpassing two meters in height. Their faces are ashen in colour, with a distinguishing bone structure with sharp tusks protruding from the sides of their mounts.

Often known as pirates and raiders, the Nausicaans are not to be trifled with.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_NorcadianHarmony_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Norcadians are native to the planet Norcadia Prime in the Delta Quadrant.

Their species has an enlarged hardened cranium. The Norcadians invented the very popular and violent martial arts sport of Tsunkatse, and often overlook slaves fighting in the Tsunkatse matches as it is an important revenue stream.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_NyberriteAlliance_desc:
£ Gamma Quadrant
Easy Difficulty

The Nyberrites are a humanoid species with distinctive yellow skin and blue hair from the planet Nyberon.

Known for being protective of their sovereignty, they nevertheless have good relations with nearby empires and often trade and recruit officers from nearby worlds.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_OrionFreeStates_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Orions are a humanoid species from the Alpha Quadrant who are known mainly for their distinctive green skin.

Orion males are typically bald and, on average, taller and more muscular than the average Human male. Orion females are very animalistic in nature, known for their extreme carnal appetites and their innate skill of seduction.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_OscheanHunters_desc:
£ Gamma Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Hunters are a humanoid species from the Gamma Quadrant, from the same homeworld as the Tosk. They are characterised by pale yellow skin, a cleft upper palate, and corrugated foreheads.

In the Hunters' culture, it is a socially acceptable way of life to chase and kill a sentient species, known as Tosk. In the past, the Hunters had developed genetic engineering to make the Tosk a worthy prey - a prey they came to respect and even admire.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_PakledBigClans_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

Pakleds are noted for their apparently underdeveloped verbal communication skills and poor technological skills, but there is more to them than their simple nature. Other species underestimate the Pakled to their own peril.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_ParadanCommonwealth_desc:
£ Gamma Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Paradan's are a race constantly at odds with each other, however when the tribes unite under the banner of the Commonwealth they are a formidable force.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_PralorAuxiliary_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Pralor, in conjunction with their long-time rivals the Cravic, are a now independent species of artificially intelligent androids. The Pralor A.P.U's were created as servants and soldiers against the Cravic in the hundred-year Pralor-Cravic war. When both sides attempted to settle and declare peace, their own creations turned against them - only to continue the war in earnest, as soon as the organics were eliminated.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_RakharianFreeStates_desc:
£ Gamma Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Rakhari are a humanoid species from the Gamma Quadrant.

The Rakhari government does not tolerate any political dissident. Their brutal civilian militia is known to kidnap known malcontents and even kill their entire family.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_RigellianConsortium_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

A species of highly developed reptilian humanoids, thought to have evolved from turtle like creatures. Rigellians are unusual in that they have at least 4 or 5 unique sexes instead of the usual 2 or 3. Historically, one of the main interactions that Rigellians have with other species is through trade, with the Rigellian Trade Commission regulating the industry.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_RomulanStarEmpire_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Easy Difficulty

The Romulans are a vulcanoid species whose homeworld is Romulus. As biological cousins to the Vulcans, they maintain the same arched and upswept eyebrows and the pointed ears with only minor differences separating them.

Historically the Romulan Star Empire formed over 1500 years ago when those Vulcans who rejected Surak's ideals departed the planet and searched for a new home.

The Romulans are known to be xenophobic and isolationist, and not above utilising slavery of lesser species to fund their civilisation.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_SaurianLeague_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Saurians are a reptilian species native to the Psi Serpentis trinary system in the Alpha Quadrant. Harsh conditions on Sauria have caused the Saurians to develop a natural robustness. The highly alcoholic Saurian brandy is but the most famous of Sauria's exports, with Saurian merchants trusted for their fairness across the quadrant.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_SelayClutches_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Selay are a humanoid reptilian species with distinctly snake like heads, whose homeworld is the planet Selay. They are engaged in a long running and often brutal rivalry with their close neighbours, the Anticans. Yet to make contact with peaceful aliens, the Selay people have been left with a bitter wound that will be slow to heal.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_SheliakCorporate_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Sheliak are a non-humanoid lifeform, believed to be silicon-based but more igneous than the Tholians.

Their official government is the Sheliak Corporate, who govern the entirety of the Sheliak.

They are known for their incomprehensible language, and place noted value on precision.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_SkrreeanRepublic_desc:
£ Gamma Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Skrreea, or Skrreeans, are an intelligent humanoid species from the Gamma Quadrant. The Skrreea live in a matriarchal society, as Skrreean males are considered far too emotional to be leaders and are constantly fighting among themselves. It is not unusual for Skrreean females to have multiple spouses. Most Skrreeans are farmers of some sort.

The Skrreea have a legend of their destined homeworld, Kentanna. It is said to be just beyond the Eye of the Universe, and a 'planet of sorrow' which the Skrreea would end and bring happiness with their arrival.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_SonaCommand_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Son'a are a species of humanoids from the planet of Ba'ku. Nomadic in nature after their self-imposed exile, they maintain outposts in space rather than colonising worlds.

The Son'a are considered a narcissistic and materialistic people, and they put great value in precious metals, rare jewels, and other materials. They are often thought to raid inhabited worlds in search for these resources, and also for slave labor, especially females.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_SulibanCabal_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Suliban are a species originating from the now-destroyed planet Sular. Following the destruction of Sular, a number of survivors grouped together to form the Suliban Cabal. 

Constructing a number of 'Helix' habitats and adopting a nomadic lifestyle, the Cabal has broadly kept to itself... 

Though rumours persist of the involvement of a hidden benefactor.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_TRogoranEmpire_desc:
£ Gamma Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The T'Rogorans are a humanoid species from the Gamma Quadrant.

The majority of the population lives without want, for hard-working slaves tend to the jobs that T'Rogorans can't. Without slaves their economy would falter.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_TalarianRepublic_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

Native to the Talar system, the Talarian race are a warp capable species with a unique society. Talarians are characterized by a distinctive hairless enlargement of the coronal area of the skull extending in two lobes to the back of the head.

Their society is rigidly patriarchal, in which a woman could never outrank a man, and at all times it encourages warrior-like behavior.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_TalaxianEmpire_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Talaxians are a humanoid species native to the Delta Quadrant.

Talaxians are generally stocky with above average musculature, with large areas of yellow to brown spotting on their heads and bodies. Their hair is usually a plume of ginger on the top of their heads.

Talaxians tend to be very friendly, as well as quite spiritual in their beliefs.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_TamarianUnity_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Tamarians, or Children of Tama, are a humanoid species from Sigma Tama IV.

Tamarians possess long slitted nostrils, and no visible auricles. Their skin is coloured light brown with several darker markings, whilst their bodies are completely hairless.

The Tamarians are known for their unique language, which is spoken entirely by allegory, referencing mythological and historical people and events from their culture.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_TellarianTechnocracy_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Easy Difficulty

The Tellarites are a sturdy humanoid species from the planet Tellar Prime in the Alpha Quadrant.

They are distinct for their porcine features, with facial features somewhat pig-like, with dark black pupils set in deep eye sockets and large snouts. Tellarites are known for their engineering skill, but also for their stubborn pride and propensity towards strong emotion.

Due to their abilities to argue about anything, they make excellent politicians.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_TheDominion_desc:
£ Gamma Quadrant
Easy Difficulty

The Dominion is a large state in the Gamma Quadrant.

Founded under the absolute rule of Changelings known as the Founders, they use sub species to enact their will. The Vorta act as commanders, administrators, scientists and diplomats for the Founders, utterly loyal to their will.

The military arm of the Dominion is run by the Jem'Hadar, a genetically engineered species who are birthed and genetically modified to be perfect soldiers. Their loyalty is guaranteed by a drug called ketracel-white, which is their sole source of food and nourishment.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_TholianAssembly_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Tholians are an extremely xenophobic, silicon based species native to the planet Tholia which is located in the outer regions of the Alpha Quadrant.

They are a quadruped crystalline species with an outer carapace through which fluid can be seen circulating murkily. Their bodies require a high temperature to function and if exposed to lower temperatures could freeze solid and shatter.

Tholians are isolationist in nature, thus making Tholian silk a highly prized and difficult commodity to obtain.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_TrabeAlliance_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Trabe are a humanoid, space-faring civilisation from the Delta Quadrant. The Trabe conquered the Kazon and integrated them into their society as slave labor, forcing them to live in squalor, separated from the Trabe, who lived in luxury. The Trabe went so far as to provoke the various Kazon sects into fighting among themselves in order to keep them under control.

Outsiders, such as the Talaxians, know the Trabe as a highly cultured species as the Trabe did not reveal the truth regarding their oppression of the Kazon, and other governments did not intervene for fear of losing trade opportunities.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_TrillRepublic_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Trill are a relatively peaceful humanoid species native to the planet Trill. They look almost entirely human, with minor differences that vary by ethnicity.

Trill from the northern hemisphere commonly have two intricate spot patterns running from the sides of their foreheads down to their toes.

Southern hemisphere Trill usually feature minor forehead ridges.

Trill are mostly known throughout the galaxy for their tradition of having a Trill Symbiont surgically implanted into their abdomen. The host and Symbiont nervous systems fuse, their brains become linked so that memories, thoughts and personalities are shared between them. When a host dies, the Symbiont must be moved to a new host, but they retain the memories and personalities of all previous hosts.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_TureiCommonwealth_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Turei are a humanoid species from the Delta Quadrant.

Cranial ridges and sharp features mark their bodies, giving them a hard looking exterior.

The Turei once led an alliance against the Vaadwaur centuries ago, breaking the Vaadwaur's hold over a large section of the Delta Quadrant, and seizing control of the subspace corridors that were used to maintain power.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_TzenkethiCoalition_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Tzenkethi are a non-humanoid four-armed reptilian race originating from the planet Ab-Tzenketh. Fiercely territorial, they will not hesitate to wage war to protect their borders.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_UndineVanguard_desc:
£ Fluidic Space
Hard Difficulty

A non-humanoid species native to a dimension called 'fluidic space', the Undine possess highly developed organic technology. Responding to hostile incursions into their home dimension, the Undine have vowed to cleanse the Milky Way Galaxy of all threats.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_UnitedCongressOfBanea_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Banea are a feathered humanoid species native to Banea in the Delta Quadrant.

A generally pleasant people, their legal system, based in courts and trials might result in severe punishment. At one point murder was punished with lethal injection. Later, murderers were forced to relive their victim's last moments periodically, by means of inserting the memory engrams of the victim into their brain.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_UnitedEarth_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Average Difficulty

United Earth is a planetary state created through the unification of Earth following first contact with the Vulcans in 2063.

With headquarters based in Paris, the United Earth government maintains control over all of the Sol system, though with recent advances at Starfleet and the Warp Five Complex there has been a large push towards expansion of United Earth interests.

In contrast to many other species, humans are difficult to assign specific attributes because they are very diverse.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_VaadwaurSupremacy_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Vaadwaur are a humanoid species from the Delta Quadrant.

Characterised by sharp ridges on their face, they also have large neck ridges that extend from their ears down along their neck and shoulders towards their chest, giving them a serpentine appearance.

The Vaadwaur were once masters of subspace tunnels called the Underspace which enabled them to have a large empire, however much of their territory has since been lost.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_ValerianFreeholds_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Valerians are a humanoid species, which supplies buyers with weapons-grade dolamide. They are popular traders close to the Cardassian Union in their homesystem of Valeria.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_ValteseSenate_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

Centuries ago the Kriosian Empire was a rich two planet empire that was known across the quadrant. Two brothers, Krios and Valt, both ran the Empire until they met an empathic metamorph named Garuth. Both brothers fell in love with her, until Krios kidnapped her and took her to Krios Prime. This sparked a civil war lasting centuries, reducing a once great Empire down to a barely warp capable people.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_VauNakatOrder_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Vau N'Akat once believed that they were the only intelligent species in the universe. Afterward, a schism developed within Vau N'Akat society between those who were tempted by the promise of other worlds and wished to align with the the galaxy and those who sought to preserve their old way of life and disdained to join a 'primitive allegiance'. Years of infighting eventually erupted into decades of civil war that left Solum irreparably devastated. But can you give them a new future?
EMPIRE_DESIGN_VidiianSodality_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

Formerly a contemplative species of artists and philosophers, the Vidiian culture underwent a radical change 2,000 years ago. A local bacteriophage that was once limited to rare fungi found only on the Northern icescapes mutated abruptly and became a highly virulent and ravaging disease.

The medical science of the Vidiians couldn't keep up with the mutation of the disease that came to be known simply as the Phage. In the millennia since, the Vidiians have sacrificed their ideals and their art in the pursuit of a cure, developed new methods of quarantines and even more brutal medical procedures, to no avail. This, more than anything, has shaped the modern Vidiian culture.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_VothTheocracy_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Easy Difficulty

The Voth are a saurian species, possibly having originated on the planet Earth but later residing in the Delta Quadrant.

Cold blooded, they have a superior sense of smell and a skin pigmentation that can be altered according to mood.

Governed by a Ministry of Elders, at the heart of their society is the Doctrine, which specifies that the Voth were the first in the Quadrant. Heresy against the Doctrine is a serious and punishable offense.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_VulcanHighCommand_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The Vulcans are a humanoid species from the planet Vulcan.

They are widely known for their logical minds and stoic culture. Physiologically the Vulcans are similar to Humans, which the exceptions being notably arched swept-up eyebrows and the distinctive auriculae of their ears, the tops of which taper into defined points.

The first contact between Vulcans and Humans occurred in 2063 when a Vulcan survey ship detected the warp flight of the Phoenix.

Whilst mostly peaceful, the Vulcans have a long history of border skirmishes with the nearby Andorians.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_WadiEmirates_desc:
£ Gamma Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Wadi are a humanoid species from the Gamma Quadrant.

The species physiology is very similar to the Human one, however, clan markings are painted on their foreheads and other parts of their bodies.

They have an unusual preoccupation with games and gambling, including the game Chula.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_XepoliteGuilds_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Xepolites are a neutral species, which trades with many species but is more than willing to engage in illegal acts when doing so. The Xepolites are from a planet named Xepol, which is located near the Cardassian border.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_XindiCouncil_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Average Difficulty

The result of an incredibly rare case of multiple convergent evolutions, the eco-system of Xindus had no less than six intelligent, tool-using species. A brutal civil war that lasted for over a century has destroyed the planet and the sixth species. Now the rest have banded together in an uneasy alliance, trying to make a future for themselves in a hostile galaxy.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_YaderanRepublic_desc:
£ Gamma Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Yaderans are a reclusive, technologically advanced species that resides in the Gamma Quadrant. For a brief time they were heralded as the galaxy's best holo-artists and AI programmers, capable of creating entirely convincing and realistic virtual worlds that could span miles.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_YridianLeague_desc:
£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The Yridians are a humanoid species. They are regarded as information merchants and smugglers, and are generally considered devious and untrustworthy. They are often serving as hired agents for other species and operating as groups or individuals. They are often unwilling to reveal information they collected without payment.

The Yridians export several beverages to other warp-capable species.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_ZahlTechnocracy_desc:
£ Delta Quadrant
Very Hard Difficulty

The Zahl are a humanoid species from the Delta Quadrant.

Physiologically they are of average height, with cranial ridges extending from their nose upwards, and a skeletal structure throughout the sides of the cranium.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_ZakdornAlliance_desc:
£ Beta Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

The pursuit of excellence drives everything in Zakdorn society and gives them a well-earned reputation as undefeated master strategists. How this reputation will be put to the test in the coming years remains to be seen.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_tngCoalitionHope_desc:
Alternate Start - Only available for the TNG Mirror map

£ Alpha Quadrant
Hard Difficulty

When the Terran Republic was defeated by the Alliance, the worlds that made up the Coalition of Hope, which tried in vain to resist the Empire reformed to create a republic of independent worlds, but freedom and liberty are hard to come by in such a hostile galaxy.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_tngTerranEmpire_desc:
Alternate Start - Only available for the TNG Mirror map

£ Alpha Quadrant
Easy Difficulty

The mighty Terran Empire, whose name sparked fear in all who heard it, has fallen. The attempted reforms of the 2260s inspired our enemies to unite and tear down our Empire, but Terrans are not so easily defeated and a broken mirror can be rebuilt with each crack reminding us of the cost of weakness.
EMPIRE_DESIGN_tngUnitedFederationofPlane:
Alternate Start - Replaces United Earth

£ Alpha Quadrant
Easy Difficulty
Early-TNG Start Only

The wars and tensions of the late 22nd century have now largely passed, and the heroes of that era are making way for new adventurers eager to explore and the final frontier. The Federation is eager to resume it's mission of exploration to boldly go where no one has gone before!
